title: Principal Data Engineer Data Technology
description:
Some careers offer more opportunities than others.

If you’re looking for further opportunities to develop your career, take the next step in fulfilling your potential right here at HSBC.

We are currently seeking a high caliber professional to join our team as **Principal Data Engineer - Data Technology.**

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for an exceptional Principal Engineer to serve as the technical anchor for the Data Technology domain, covering platforms and capabilities including Enterprise Data Assets (EDA), Reference Data, Big Data & Movement, and Data Decisioning engineering.

This role will drive technical strategy, architecture, and engineering excellence across distributed data platforms that are foundational to data democratization, AI enablement, customer insight, and regulatory compliance. The Principal Engineer will provide hands-on leadership in modern data and digital engineering practices, hybrid cloud enablement, event-driven architecture, and platform scalability to ensure enterprise-ready and future-fit data services.

This role is suited for a senior technologist with deep experience in data platform engineering and the ability to influence product and delivery teams across a large, global, matrixed organization.

**In this role you will:**

  

* Define and evolve the reference engineering standards for core data provisioning platforms, ensuring alignment to the bank’s Group Data Strategy and Data Future State Architecture.
* Provide deep technical standards and approach leadership across key platforms:-
* + Enterprise Data Assets (EDA) and APIs for standardized data provisioning
  + Reference Data Services for golden source alignment and hierarchy management
  + Big Data and Movement technologies for ingestion, streaming, and transformation at scale
  + Decisioning Infrastructure including real-time feature stores and orchestration
* Lead peer reviews and ensure platform consistency, reusability, and compliance with enterprise standards.
* Guide development teams in implementing data pipelines, APIs, metadata-driven controls, and automated testing frameworks.
* Champion DevSecOps, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code across engineering teams.
* Drive the control transition to using agentic AI coding assistants.
* Lead the technology Developer Experience, enabling the whole of technology to discover, understand and onboard themselves to our services.
* Drive best practices in observability, performance engineering, cost optimization, and scalability in hybrid cloud environments.
* Mentor senior engineers and influence technical delivery across multiple squads and geographies.
* Collaborate with Architecture, Cybersecurity, CDO, and business product owners to align engineering outcomes to strategic objectives.
* Represent the domain in cross-platform technology councils and architecture forums.

**What you will need to succeed in the role:**

  

* Relevant & hands-on experience at senior level in data platform engineering, architecture, or software development, preferably in a global financial institution or scaled enterprise.
* Expertise in building large-scale data pipelines, APIs, and event-driven systems using modern frameworks and technologies (e.g., Spring, Kafka, Spark, etc).
* Ability to actively write & deliver code is essential
* Strong architectural understanding of data mesh, data lakehouse, and real-time, customer-facing operational & analytics platforms.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS and GCP), containerisation, and IaC tools.
* Deep familiarity with development tooling and automation covering modeling, observability, resilience, and , and governance patterns.
* Strong track record of building reusable platform services that accelerate delivery for data consumers and AI/ML initiatives.
* Experience with enterprise reference data management and integration is highly desirable.
* Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to engage and guide both engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders.

**You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.**

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Your Team Responsibilities:

The DevOps Platform Engineering team builds and runs the tooling, platforms and workflows that every engineering team at MSCI uses to deliver software. We operate as a software engineering team whose customers are other engineers — we build internal products, APIs, automation and integrations, and we run them as products with roadmaps, users and service commitments.

We own and maintain several Developer tools in MSCI's developer toolchain end to end. That covers the tools engineers work in every day, including GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube and Cursor, as well as the platforms we build and run ourselves such as our Backstage-based internal developer portal. Ownership here means we select, integrate, secure, operate and continuously improve these services, and we are accountable for their availability,and adoption across the firm.

Alongside the tools, we enable standardisation across the software development lifecycle. We define the golden paths, reusable CI/CD workflows, platform abstractions, engineering standards and governance models that product and engineering teams adopt so they can move quickly without re-solving the same problems.

As part of the MSCI Core DevOps Engineering team, you will help shape where software delivery and developer enablement go next across the organisation.

**What the team owns**

* Developer tooling: GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube, Docker, Cursor
* Internal developer platforms: Backstage-based developer portal and our in-house developer productivity platform
* CI/CD platforms, reusable pipelines and release automation
* SDLC standards, golden paths and governance models
* Self-service capabilities, internal APIs and integrations that remove manual toil from engineering teams
* Developer experience measurement, adoption and the services we provide to engineering teams across MSCI

Your Key Responsibilities:

* Build and maintain reusable CI/CD frameworks, GitHub Actions workflows, templates, and platform abstractions that make the golden paths the fastest way to ship software at MSCI — simple enough to adopt quickly, flexible enough for diverse engineering use cases.
* Develop and support internal platform capabilities, APIs, automation services, and integrations across the developer toolchain, including GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube, Cursor, Backstage, and our in-house developer productivity platform.
* Run the developer tooling estate as a product: monitor health and usage, resolve issues, manage upgrades and configuration, and improve the reliability of services engineers depend on daily.
* Apply proactive problem solving to developer pain points — find friction in engineering workflows before it is escalated, trace issues to root cause, and deliver durable fixes rather than workarounds.
* Bring intellectual curiosity and a critical thinking mindset to platform decisions: evaluate new tools, patterns, and approaches on their merits, and make evidence-based recommendations that raise the quality of what we deliver to our developers.
* Contribute to SDLC standardization initiatives and engineering best practices, translating agreed standards into working automation, templates, and controls.
* Partner with Security, Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure, Risk, and Application Engineering teams to embed governance, compliance, and operational controls directly into engineering workflows and platform capabilities.
* Treat engineering teams as customers: gather feedback, document and support what you build.

Your skills and experience that will help you excel:

Required

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* Hands on Programming experience in Go or Java.
* Experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps Engineering, or related software engineering roles.
* Software engineering mindset, with hands-on experience building automation, APIs, internal tooling, or reusable workflows that other engineers depend on.
* Solid working experience with SCM and CI/CD tooling such as GitHub (preferred), Azure DevOps, and/or GitLab, including repositories, pipelines, reusable workflows and templates, permissions, and integrations.
* Good understanding of the SDLC and software delivery workflows, including source control governance, branching strategies, release processes, and developer enablement practices.
* Experience building and consuming REST APIs and webhooks.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills
* Operational mindset, with experience supporting tooling or services that other teams rely on in production.
* Intellectual curiosity and critical thinking — willingness to dig into unfamiliar problems, question how things work today, and evidence a better way.

Nice to Have

* Exposure to an internal developer platform or portal (Backstage or equivalent).
* Experience building self-service engineering workflows or developer enablement tooling.
* Experience with platform observability, engineering metrics, or developer productivity initiatives.
* Exposure to GitOps frameworks.
* Experience in GitHub Enterprise Platform & Services
* Familiarity with frontend technologies such as React and TypeScript for platform UI and tooling development.
* Agentic SDLC experience and AI-native development.

About MSCI:

**What we offer you**

* Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
* Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
* A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
* A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
* Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.
* Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles.
* We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.

At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry.

MSCI strengthens global markets by connecting participants across the financial ecosystem with a common language. Our research-based data, analytics and indexes, supported by advanced technology, set standards for global investors and help our clients understand risks and opportunities so they can make better decisions and unlock innovation. We serve asset managers and owners, private-market sponsors and investors, hedge funds, wealth managers, banks, insurers and corporates.

title: MCIM Engineer
description:
**Date:** 16 Oct 2026

**Location:** IN

**Company:** Digital Edge DC

**Who we are:**

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading data center platform in Asia Pacific, delivering sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure at scale. Headquartered in Singapore and backed by Stonepeak, we operate a rapidly expanding platform with over 30 data centers and 1.8GW of secured IT power across key markets.

Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering the populations they serve. We differentiate through execution – delivering at speed and at scale while combining global standards with deep local expertise. This enables us to provide consistent, sustainable and high-performance infrastructure for hyperscalers and enterprises across the region.

As Asia Pacific’s digital transformation accelerates, Digital Edge is building the infrastructure that powers the next wave of AI and cloud growth. Joining Digital Edge means being part of a high-growth platform at the forefront of AI and cloud infrastructure, where you can make a tangible impact on Asia-Pacific’s digital future.

**Our values:**

  

* **Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.**
* **Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.**
* **Strive: We are driven and determined.**
* **Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.**
* **Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.**
  

**What we need:**

  

The MCIM Engineer is accountable for country and site-level administration, data integrity, workflow compliance and operational adoption of the Mission Critical Infrastructure Management platform across assigned data center facilities. Reporting directly to the in-country Manager, Operations Support, with a dotted-line reporting relationship to the platform Director, MCIM and Asset Management, the role ensures critical assets, maintenance activities, incidents, operational changes, corrective actions and supporting evidence are accurately managed through MCIM as the authoritative operational system of record.

  

The role acts as the primary interface between Facility Operations and the central MCIM Platform team, translating platform standards, asset taxonomies, workflows and governance requirements into disciplined country and site-level execution. The MCIM Engineer supports users, monitors compliance, validates operational data, coordinates system improvements and ensures activities undertaken by employees, contractors and service providers are complete, traceable and audit-ready.

  

The Director, MCIM and Asset Management owns platform strategy, system standards, core workflow design, configuration governance, asset taxonomy and cross-country standardization. The in-country Manager, Operations Support owns local leadership, prioritization and integration of MCIM requirements into country operations. Facility Operations remains accountable for the safe and correct execution of operational work. The MCIM Engineer does not replace these accountabilities but ensures the work is properly planned, controlled, recorded and evidenced through the platform.

  

**Key responsibilities:**

  

* Own country and site-level MCIM administration, adoption, data integrity and workflow compliance across assigned data center facilities, ensuring the platform is consistently used for applicable asset, maintenance, incident, change, corrective-action and operational activities.
* Maintain complete and accurate critical infrastructure asset records, including asset classifications, hierarchies, technical attributes, equipment relationships, dependencies, maintenance requirements, lifecycle status and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate asset-data preparation, validation, migration and reconciliation during new facility delivery, commissioning, operational readiness, expansion, retrofit, equipment replacement and decommissioning activities.
* Administer preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance workflows within MCIM, ensuring work orders are properly planned, authorized, assigned, executed, evidenced, reviewed and closed in accordance with approved maintenance strategies and operating requirements.
* Govern site-level incident, root cause and corrective-action records, ensuring events are correctly classified, escalated and linked to affected assets, with complete evidence and timely investigation, verification and closure of corrective and preventive actions.
* Administer operational change workflows, verifying that changes include the required scope, risk assessment, technical and operational review, authorization, implementation planning, asset linkage, communications, execution evidence and post-implementation validation.
* Monitor data quality and workflow performance, identifying incomplete records, untracked activities, duplicated data, configuration inconsistencies, control gaps and deviations from approved platform standards, and coordinating timely corrective action.
* Support MCIM implementation, configuration, enhancement, upgrade, integration, pilot and user acceptance testing activities, documenting operational requirements and validating that workflows and system outputs are effective for live data center operations.
* Develop operational dashboards and recurring reports, provide user training and first-line process support, and support internal and customer audits through accurate records, traceable workflows, complete evidence and timely remediation of identified gaps.
  

Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.

  

**The successful candidate:**

  

* Relevant experience in data center operations, critical facilities, infrastructure asset management, maintenance planning, operational systems administration or a comparable mission-critical or high-availability environment.
* Relevant degree, diploma or professional qualification in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, building services engineering, facilities management, information systems, asset management or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Practical experience using or administering CMMS, DCIM, EAM, work-order management, asset-management, maintenance-management or comparable operational platforms.
* Strong working knowledge of asset lifecycle management, preventive and corrective maintenance, incident management, change control, operational risk assessment, corrective-action management and audit evidence requirements.
* Demonstrated experience maintaining accurate asset and operational data, resolving data-quality issues and record inconsistencies, and producing reliable operational reports and dashboards.
* Experience supporting system implementation, workflow configuration, data migration, platform enhancement, user acceptance testing or the integration of operational technology and enterprise systems.
* Sound understanding of data center critical infrastructure, including electrical, mechanical, controls, monitoring, life-safety and associated building systems.
* Proven ability to work across Facility Operations, Engineering Operations, digital platform teams, project teams, contractors, vendors and service providers, supported by strong analytical, organizational, documentation and problem-solving capability.
* Must have strong English-language verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to deliver user training, prepare high-quality operational reports, communicate compliance requirements and engage technical and senior stakeholders; familiarity with applicable asset management, quality, information security, business continuity, safety, environmental and ISO management systems is advantageous.
  

Join us to shape the future of Digital Infrastructure in Asia. Apply now for a confidential career discussion.

title: Manager - QA
description:
### **Description**

Davies is looking for an experienced Manager - Software Quality Assurance (QA) to lead the quality engineering function and ensure reliable, secure, and high-quality software delivery across products and platforms. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Development, this role will be accountable for QA strategy, people leadership, test governance, automation direction, release readiness, quality metrics, and continuous improvement. The successful candidate will combine strong quality engineering expertise with the ability to lead teams, influence delivery stakeholders, manage risks, and embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle.

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Define and own the QA strategy, operating model, standards, processes, and roadmap across software delivery teams.
* Lead, coach, and develop QA engineers, including objective setting, regular feedback, capability development, workload planning, and performance support.
* Establish risk-based test strategies covering functional, regression, integration, data validation, API, performance, security, accessibility, and user acceptance testing, as applicable.
* Own test planning, estimation, resourcing, prioritization, and execution across multiple projects, releases, and delivery teams.
* Drive the test automation strategy, framework governance, tool selection, coverage improvement, maintainability, and integration into CI/CD pipelines.
* Partner with product, engineering, architecture, business, and delivery leaders to define acceptance criteria, non-functional requirements, quality gates, and release readiness.
* Provide clear go/no-go recommendations based on test evidence, defect risk, business impact, and agreed quality thresholds.
* Define, monitor, and report quality metrics such as defect leakage, automation coverage, test effectiveness, execution progress, escaped defects, and release risk.
* Oversee defect triage and ensure defects are clearly documented, prioritized, resolved, retested, and communicated to relevant stakeholders.
* Champion shift-left quality practices, including early QA involvement, requirements reviews, testability reviews, developer testing, and continuous validation.
* Ensure test environments, test data, tools, and dependencies are planned and available to support predictable delivery.
* Identify quality, delivery, and operational risks early; agree mitigation plans and escalate material risks appropriately.
* Continuously improve QA efficiency through automation, reusable assets, better engineering practices, and appropriate use of AI-assisted testing capabilities.
* Manage QA suppliers or partners where applicable, ensuring delivery quality, transparency, and alignment with Davies standards.
* Build a strong quality engineering community of practice and promote consistent standards, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.
* Support audits, regulatory expectations, and governance requirements by maintaining appropriate test evidence, traceability, and documentation.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years of software quality assurance or quality engineering experience, including significant test automation experience.
* 3+ years of experience leading QA engineers or managing quality delivery across multiple teams or workstreams.
* Experience delivering quality assurance for web applications, APIs, integrations, data platforms, or enterprise systems
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments and collaborating with distributed, cross-functional teams.

  

### **About Davies**

We are a specialist professional services and technology firm, working in partnership with leading insurance, highly regulated and global businesses.  
  
We help our clients to manage risk, operate their core business processes, transform and grow. We deliver professional services and technology solutions across the risk and insurance value chain, including excellence in claims, underwriting, distribution, regulation & risk, customer experience, human capital, digital transformation & change management.  
  
Our global team of more than 8,000 professionals operate across ten countries, including the UK & the U.S. Over the past ten years Davies has grown its annual revenues more than 20-fold, investing heavily in research & development, innovation & automation, colleague development, and client service. Today the group serves more than 1,500 insurance, financial services, public sector, and other highly regulated clients.

title: Lead Database Reliability Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

**Lead Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) - Oracle RAC**

**Self-Managed Oracle RAC | HA/DR | Performance | Automation | Engineering Influence**

**Level**

Lead DBRE

**Domain**

Oracle RAC and Mission-Critical Relational Infrastructure

**Primary Focus**

Hands-on Oracle RAC reliability, lifecycle ownership, technical escalation, automation, application partnership, and cross-functional execution

**Work Expectations**

U.S. Eastern Time business hours; on-call participation as required

**1. Role Summary**
===================

We are seeking an experienced Lead DBRE with deep hands-on expertise in Oracle Database and self-managed Oracle RAC environments. The role owns technical execution for a major Oracle domain and improves reliability, performance, scalability, lifecycle management, automation, and operational discipline.

Beyond traditional DBA operations, the Lead DBRE partners with application and infrastructure teams to influence schema, SQL, connection management, resiliency, observability, and safe deployment practices. The role remains hands-on while providing technical leadership, mentoring, and incident escalation.

**2. Level Scope and Leadership Expectations**
==============================================

Lead DBRE is a senior technical leadership role focused on owning execution for a major database domain. The expectation is to solve difficult production problems, lead initiatives end to end, guide engineers, create durable operating standards, and drive cross-functional closure without default people-management responsibility.

**Dimension**

**Expectation at This Level**

**Scope of Ownership**

Owns reliability and execution for a significant Oracle platform domain, including incidents, lifecycle activities, routine maintenance, capacity risks, HA/DR readiness, and service-impacting improvements.

**Technical Depth**

Diagnoses complex RAC, Clusterware, ASM, Data Guard, SQL performance, storage, interconnect, OS, backup, and recovery problems.

**Technical Leadership**

Acts as a primary escalation point, mentors engineers, reviews designs, raises standards, and influences application and infrastructure decisions.

**Execution**

Leads complex initiatives end to end, aligns stakeholders, manages dependencies, and drives permanent corrective actions to closure.

**Communication**

Explains technical tradeoffs, communicates clearly during incidents, and keeps risks, ownership, dependencies, and timelines visible.

**Automation and Standards**

Builds repeatable automation, CI/CD practices, runbooks, monitoring, and golden paths that reduce toil and failure risk.

**3. Key Responsibilities**
===========================

**A. Oracle RAC Platform Ownership**
------------------------------------

* Administer and improve Oracle RAC, Grid Infrastructure, Clusterware, ASM, services, SCAN/listeners, and interconnect configurations.
* Plan and execute patching, upgrades, migrations, capacity changes, and lifecycle activities with controlled change and rollback practices.
* Design, operate, and validate Data Guard, RMAN, backup/recovery, failover, switchover, and disaster-recovery procedures.

**B. Performance and Incident Leadership**
------------------------------------------

* Lead performance analysis using AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQL Monitor, execution plans, SQL Trace, TKPROF, and OS/storage diagnostics.
* Diagnose Cache Fusion, GC waits, workload placement, connection storms, cluster instability, storage latency, and interconnect issues.
* Serve as the technical escalation point for critical incidents, lead stabilization and RCA, and drive permanent corrective actions.

**C. Engineering Influence and Shift-Left Reliability**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Partner with application teams on SQL, indexing, partitioning, schema design, bind usage, connection pooling, transaction boundaries, and resilient failover behavior.
* Establish database design reviews, deployment guardrails, developer guidance, and production-readiness standards.

**D. Automation and Observability**
-----------------------------------

* Automate provisioning, validation, patching, maintenance, backup checks, DR exercises, health checks, and recurring remediation using Python, Shell, Ansible, Terraform, or similar technologies.
* Improve Oracle observability using OEM, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Splunk, or comparable tools; define actionable service indicators and objectives.

**4. Required Qualifications and Experience**
=============================================

* 8+ years of database or reliability engineering experience, including significant Lead or Senior responsibility for self-managed production Oracle RAC.
* Deep hands-on knowledge of Oracle RAC, Grid Infrastructure/Clusterware, ASM, Data Guard, RMAN, RAC Services, SCAN/listeners, Cache Fusion, and interconnect behavior.
* Strong Oracle performance tuning and diagnostics experience using AWR, ASH, execution plans, SQL Trace, and Linux diagnostics.
* Experience with patching, upgrades, migrations, backup/recovery, DR exercises, and controlled production change.
* Strong Linux/Unix systems troubleshooting skills.
* Hands-on automation using Python, Shell, Ansible, Terraform, or comparable tooling.
* Strong technical leadership, mentoring, incident communication, and cross-functional execution skills.

**5. Preferred Qualifications**
===============================

* Oracle Exadata, OCI, Cloud@Customer, AWS, or hybrid Oracle deployment experience.
* Application Continuity, FAN, TAF, FSFO, Far Sync, GoldenGate, GDS, TDE, ZDLRA, or advanced Oracle HA capabilities.
* Database schema CI/CD using Liquibase, Flyway, Bytebase, or comparable tooling.
* Oracle certifications or relevant SRE/cloud architecture credentials.

**6. Expected Outcomes in the First 6-12 Months**
=================================================

* Establish measurable reliability, MTTR, patching, backup/recovery, and DR-readiness baselines and deliver material improvement.
* Automate high-frequency and high-risk operational workflows, prioritizing safety, maintainability, and auditability.
* Establish a practical database architecture and production-readiness review process with measurable adoption by application teams.
* Deliver documented capacity, lifecycle, resiliency, and corrective-action plans for critical RAC environments.

**7. What This Role Does Not Include**
======================================

* This is not a people-management role unless separately assigned; leadership is expected through technical direction, mentoring, and execution ownership.
* This is not a project-management-only role; the Lead DBRE must remain deeply hands-on.

**8. Work Expectations and Location**
=====================================

This role requires working during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours and participating in on-call support as required.

title: WAN & Network Service Delivery Manager
description:
WAN & Network Service Delivery Manager

**We offer:**
=============

The WAN & Network Service Delivery Manager combines two equally important responsibilities within KION's Enterprise Network service. Approximately 50% of the role governs the global WAN managed service, and approximately 50% coordinates service delivery and BAU operations across Campus LAN, Wi-Fi, WAN and DDI.

For WAN governance, the role monitors supplier delivery, contractual performance, service levels, lifecycle, risks, costs and improvement actions. The role prepares analysis, forecasts, recommendations and decision proposals for the Enterprise Network Service Owner. Budget accountability, cost-centre responsibility, contract ownership and final commercial decisions remain with the Enterprise Network Service Owner. Day-to-day operational coordination with the WAN managed service provider is performed by a designated WAN Operations Coordinator under the functional guidance of this role; overall WAN governance responsibility remains with this position.

For network service delivery, the role coordinates the shared operating model, queues, incidents, service requests, changes, problems, operational readiness and performance reporting. The role has no disciplinary or matrix people-management responsibility for network engineers. Engineering capacity and line management remain with the responsible managers, while this role provides process coordination, prioritisation transparency and cross-domain escalation.

The role works closely with the Enterprise Network Service Owner, Lead Network Architect, network engineers, IT Service Management, regional IT teams, Procurement, Finance and external network providers.

**Tasks and Qualifications:**
=============================

  

**1. WAN governance, roadmap and lifecycle - 15%**

* Prepare and maintain the proposed WAN service roadmap in alignment with the Enterprise Network Service Owner and Lead Network Architect.

* Identify lifecycle, resilience, capacity, sourcing and technical-debt risks and prepare recommendations for accountable decision makers.

* Track approved governance decisions and improvement actions to completion.

**2. WAN supplier and contractual-performance governance - 15%**

* Act as the primary operational governance interface for the WAN managed service provider, carriers and access providers.

* Monitor SLAs, KPIs, contractual obligations, potential service credits, risks and supplier commitments.

* Prepare evidence and recommendations for contract, renewal and commercial decisions owned by the Enterprise Network Service Owner.

* Lead supplier service reviews and escalate recurring underperformance, weak corrective actions and unresolved risks.

**3. WAN cost transparency, demand and transition assurance - 10%**

* Prepare cost, consumption and forecast transparency for review and approval by the Enterprise Network Service Owner; the role has no budget or cost-centre accountability.

* Assess the WAN service, supplier, commercial and operational implications of approved demands.

* Coordinate provider estimates, service acceptance and transition requirements with the demand owner, Lead Network Architect and Enterprise Network Service Owner.

* Ensure operational acceptance covers documentation, monitoring, testing, support routes, supplier acceptance and handover.

**4. WAN performance, data and continual improvement - 10%**

* Maintain WAN scorecards covering availability, incidents, capacity, resilience, change quality, supplier performance and cost transparency.

* Coordinate supplier follow-up after significant interruptions, including RCA quality and preventive actions.

* Maintain accurate governance artefacts and promote consistent data across ITSM, CMDB, monitoring, inventory and source-of-truth capabilities.

* Identify opportunities for automation, observability, data-quality improvement and reduced manual coordination.

**5. Enterprise Network operations coordination - 20%**

* Coordinate the BAU operating model across Campus LAN, Wi-Fi, WAN and DDI without assuming disciplinary or matrix people-management responsibility.

* Run queue reviews, service-health reviews and handover checkpoints; make ageing, blocked work and coverage gaps transparent.

* Coordinate operational priorities with line managers and engineering leads and escalate unresolved capacity conflicts to the Service Owner.

* Provide functional guidance to the designated WAN Operations Coordinator responsible for daily KION-provider coordination.

**6. Incident and service-request coordination - 15%**

* Coordinate triage, ownership, progression and documentation for incidents and service requests in the shared Enterprise Network queue.

* Coordinate cross-domain and high-priority incidents, bringing together network, security, application, infrastructure and supplier teams.

* Ensure clear ownership, timely escalation, stakeholder communication and disciplined technical handovers; specialist teams retain technical resolution responsibility.

* Monitor ticket ageing, reassignments and documentation quality and drive corrective action where required.

**7. Change, problem and operational-readiness governance - 10%**

* Coordinate operational risk reviews for significant or high-risk network changes, including production dependencies and rollback readiness.

* Drive follow-up of recurring problems, RCAs, known errors and preventive actions.

* Confirm that new or changed services enter BAU with monitoring, documentation, runbooks, support ownership, access and escalation routes in place.

**8. Operational performance and service improvement - 5%**

* Report queue health, response and restoration performance, recurring incidents, backlog, monitoring coverage and handover quality.

* Maintain and improve SOPs, runbooks, escalation contacts, service maps and operational knowledge.

Use operational trends to recommend improvements to resilience, automation, standards and training  

  

Interfaces

Internal:

* Secure Connectivity platform leadership, functional and team leads, and rotating operations engineers

* Enterprise and Network architecture; Cybersecurity and Information Security

* IT Service Management, e.g. Service Desk, (Major) Incident, Problem and Change

* Procurement, Legal, Finance/Controlling and Vendor Management

* Regional and onsite IT, business partners, programme and project managers

* Cloud, datacentre, workplace, decentralised infrastructure and application teams

External:

* Telecommunications carriers and local access providers

* Managed network and security service providers

* Network technology vendors, integrators and professional-services partners

* Auditors and specialist advisers where required

title: Senior Citrix XenServer & VDI Engineer
description:
**About Dataction:**

Dataction is a new age services firm that offers best in class information technology, analytics, and consulting services to renowned international companies. Dataction was established in 2010 and has grown rapidly over the last decade. Dataction has built a reputation for providing differentiated and reliable services to a wide range of customers across multiple sectors.

At Dataction we connect every dot and reimagine every business process. Our lean, agile, and analytical approach towards problem solving and execution, helps our client achieve sustainable growth and secure a profitable business, while safeguarding a viable future. Our people are committed, courageous, and unafraid of pushing boundaries. They help our clients make decisions that deliver immediate and measurable benefits, justifying investments. Our engagement models provide the perfect blend of quality, control, and cost for our customers.

To know more about Dataction, please visit https://dataction.co

**Job Purpose:**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Citrix XenServer & VDI Engineer to build the target Citrix XenServer platform and migrate our client's VDI estate off VMware safely and on schedule. The client's VMware licences expire in November 2026, so this is a time-critical, hands-on delivery role. The successful candidate will act as the senior technical authority for the VDI migration across 10 HPE ProLiant hosts: ~400 VDI desktops moving from VMware vSphere 8.0 to Citrix XenServer. He/She will plan and run a rolling host-by-host migration, protect the end-user experience throughout, work closely with the client's Citrix team and the Hyper-V workstream, and leave behind documentation the client's operations team can run with.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Citrix XenServer Platform Build & Management**
  + Build and configure Citrix XenServer / Citrix Hypervisor hosts and resource pools on HPE ProLiant hardware (10 hosts), including iLO, firmware/SPP, and hardware compatibility compliance.
  + Configure storage repositories (iSCSI/FC/NFS with multipathing), NIC bonding, networks/VLANs, and pool HA to match the existing VMware design.
  + Manage the estate via XenCenter and the xe CLI, including pool master design, Active Directory integration, role-based access, and host update/hotfix lifecycle.
  + Size and tune pool capacity (CPU, memory, storage IOPS, read caching) for ~400 concurrent desktops.
  + Integrate the new hosts with Active Directory, DNS, monitoring, and patching tooling.
* **Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops Integration**
  + Work with the client's Citrix team to create hosting connections and resources from the Delivery Controllers to the new XenServer pools.
  + Prepare and optimise golden images for XenServer (XenServer VM Tools, Citrix VDA, Citrix Optimizer) and rebuild machine catalogs using MCS/PVS.
  + Validate machine catalog and delivery group configuration, power management, and provisioning behaviour after each stage.
  + Validate VDI performance, user logon experience, profile management (FSLogix / Citrix Profile Management), and capacity after each stage of the migration.
* **VDI Migration Planning & Execution (VMware Exit)**
  + Assess the VMware vSphere 8.0 VDI estate (hosts, catalogs, golden images, persistent vs non-persistent desktops, networks, datastores) and produce the migration plan and schedule against the 11 November 2026 deadline.
  + Run a rolling migration: evacuate a host, rebuild it as XenServer, move desktop capacity in phases by delivery group/user population, and repeat, avoiding disruption to users.
  + Rebuild non-persistent catalogs from new XenServer golden images and convert persistent desktops using Citrix XenServer Conversion Manager or other V2V tooling, including VMware Tools removal and XenServer VM Tools installation.
  + Define pilot, UAT, validation, and rollback procedures for each stage, and coordinate change windows, out-of-hours activity, and user communications with the client.
  + Decommission VMware hosts once desktops are verified and signed off.
* **Security, Automation & Handover**
  + Apply security hardening to XenServer hosts and golden images aligned to CIS Benchmarks, Microsoft Security Baselines, and vendor guidance.
  + Establish patching and lifecycle processes for XenServer hosts, VDAs, and golden images.
  + Automate repetitive build, image, and migration tasks using PowerShell (Citrix PowerShell SDK, XenServer SDK) and the xe CLI.
  + Produce build documentation, runbooks, and operational handover for the client's infrastructure and Citrix teams, and brief them on day-to-day management.
  + Coordinate with the Hyper-V server workstream on shared hardware, networks, storage, and the overall migration schedule.

**Qualification, Skills and Experience:**

* **10+ years** of relevant experience in virtualisation and end-user computing / VDI infrastructure, with deep hands-on expertise in Citrix XenServer / Citrix Hypervisor.
* **Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science**, Information Technology or Engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience with Citrix XenServer / Citrix Hypervisor, including host builds, resource pools, storage repositories, multipathing, NIC bonding, pool HA, XenCenter, and the xe CLI.
* Strong experience with Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, including Delivery Controllers, hosting connections, machine catalogs, delivery groups, and MCS/PVS.
* Proven experience running VDI at scale (400+ desktops), including golden image build, optimisation, and VDA lifecycle management.
* Proven experience migrating VDI workloads between hypervisors with minimal user disruption, using Citrix XenServer Conversion Manager or image-rebuild approaches.
* Good understanding of VMware vSphere/ESXi 7.x/8.x, including vCenter, VMware Tools removal, and host decommissioning.
* Hands-on experience with HPE ProLiant servers, including iLO, firmware/SPP compliance, and Smart Array configuration.
* Good understanding of storage and SAN technologies, including Fibre Channel, iSCSI, NFS, and multipathing, and storage performance/IOPS sizing for VDI.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, VLANs, LACP/NIC bonding, switching, firewalls, and Citrix HDX/ICA traffic.
* Strong experience with Windows 10/11 desktop and Windows Server administration, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy management.
* Experience with user profile management (FSLogix / Citrix Profile Management) and VDI performance and logon troubleshooting using Citrix Director or similar tools.
* Hands-on experience with PowerShell scripting (including the Citrix PowerShell SDK) for automation, administration, and migration tasks.
* Experience implementing security baselines and hardening standards for hosts and golden images, and managing patching across hypervisors and desktops.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across XenServer, Citrix, Windows, networking, storage, and other infrastructure layers.
* Experience producing migration runbooks, cutover plans, rollback procedures, and working within change management processes.
* Excellent documentation and communication skills, with the ability to clearly document technical solutions, operational procedures, and handover material.
* Exposure to Microsoft Hyper-V or Citrix DaaS / Citrix Cloud is desirable.
* Prior VMware exit / hypervisor replatforming project experience is desirable.
* Relevant certifications are desirable: Citrix (CCA-V / CCP-V) or VMware Certified Professional – Data Center Virtualization (VCP-DCV).

**Why should you join Dataction?**

title: Data Engineer II
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Data Engineer IIOverview  
We are looking for a Data Engineer to join the Data Engineer team. This is a pivotal role, responsible for supporting multiple Data Analysts and Data Scientists day-to-day and assisting various data-driven requests across the company. The position involves a wide variety of technical skills, from coding to infrastructure, from data analysis to database management. The ideal candidate will have experience working with large-scale data and building automated data ETL processes for large-scale data analysis. ODS or data warehousing experience would be ideal.  
  
Key responsibilities include:  

* Build and maintain database technologies, environments, and applications, seeking opportunities for improvements and efficiencies
* Should be familiar and have experience in cloud data platforms like Databricks and/or Cloudera, Iceberg/Delta tables
* Writes SQL statement procedures to optimize SQL execution and query development
* Effectively utilizes various technology like Spark (Scala, Python), Apache Kafka, Trino
* Manages the deployment of data solutions that are optimally standardized and database updates to meet project deliverables
* Leads database security posture, which includes proactively identifying security risks and implementing both risk mitigation plans and control functions
* Supports process improvement efforts to identify and test opportunities for automation and/or reduction in time to deployment
* Participating in the entire solution development cycle from requirement gathering to solution deployment.
* Working with multiple stakeholders across teams to fulfill ad-hoc investigations, including large-scale data extraction, transformation, and analyses.
* Supporting production code to produce comprehensive and accurate data artifacts.
* Promoting strategies to improve our data modeling, quality, and architecture.

  
All About You:  
Should have experience working with Databricks and/or Cloudera platforms  
Skilled in Spark framework (Scala/Python), Apache Kafka, Spark Streaming  
Highly skilled in SQL knowledge and relational databases.  
Experienced with developing and maintaining data pipelines for the extraction, transformation, and/or loading of large-scale data.  
Experienced with working with large data sets. You’ve implemented parallel processing and have dealt with the limitations and challenges of working with terabytes of data.  
Strong analytics skills related to working with unstructured datasets.
  
Experienced with performing root cause analysis on internal and external data and processes to answer specific business questions and identify opportunities for improvement.
  
Experienced with database administration and query optimization with different databases.  
Experienced with at least one of the programming languages like Python  
Capable of effectively communicating requirements and solutions to audiences with different skill sets.
  
Familiarity with the core requirements of data analysis and/or presentation.  
Focused, innovative, and self-sufficient problem solver who is willing to independently and creatively deep-dive into an issue, cut to the heart of a problem, and solve it.
  
Bonus Points if:
  
You have any prior experience with any of the following:
  

* AWS; S3, EMR, Ozone, Iceberg
* Python, Javascript, PLSQL, regex
* Jenkins, Datadog, Splunk, Dynatrace

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Test Engineer
description:
**Who we are**
--------------

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Software Tester with experience in Telecom BSS/OSS environments to support the delivery of high-quality system changes across Fixed Line, Home Broadband, customer care, order management, and provisioning journeys. This role is focused on System Integration Testing (SIT), end-to-end validation, defect management, and quality assurance across complex business and technology landscapes. The successful candidate will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure solutions are delivered in line with business requirements, quality standards, and release objectives.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Analyse business and functional requirements, participate in walkthroughs, and assess testing impacts across applications, systems, and customer journeys.
* Define SIT scope, estimate testing effort, and prepare test plans, schedules, test scenarios, test cases, and requirement traceability artefacts.
* Execute System Integration Testing, end-to-end testing, integration testing, and regression testing across complex business and technical processes.
* Validate functional requirements, system integrations, interfaces, data flows, order processing activities, and downstream outcomes.
* Prepare and maintain suitable test data and ensure supporting test environments are available for planned execution activities.
* Log, track, retest, and close defects using Microsoft Azure DevOps and actively participate in defect triage discussions.
* Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with Business, Development, Release Management, and supplier teams to support timely defect resolution.
* Provide clear updates on test execution, defects, risks, issues, and dependencies, supporting evidence-based Go/No-Go recommendations.
* Maintain testing metrics, quality dashboards, and test evidence in accordance with SDLC and STLC governance requirements.
* Apply automation testing knowledge to identify suitable regression scenarios, support automated test execution, analyse results, and collaborate on script maintenance activities.
* Contribute to reusable test assets, shift-left testing practices, process standardisation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Coordinate test closure activities, capture lessons learned, and support the implementation of agreed improvements in future deliveries.

**Who you are**
---------------

* Minimum of 3 years' experience in software testing across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Proven hands-on experience in System Integration Testing, end-to-end testing, integration testing, regression testing, and defect management.
* Good understanding of Fixed Line, Home Broadband, telecom customer journeys, order management, and provisioning processes.
* Experience using testing tools, particularly Microsoft Azure DevOps.
* Strong knowledge of test planning, requirements traceability, quality metrics, and test reporting.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, root cause analysis, communication, and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to work effectively within matrix teams involving onshore, offshore, business, technology, and supplier stakeholders.
* Telecom, BSS/OSS, or customer care domain experience is preferred.
* ISTQB or ISEB certification is preferred.
* Experience working within complex, large-scale release environments is desirable.

Worried that you don’t meet all the desired criteria exactly? At Vodafone we are passionate about empowering people and creating a workplace where everyone can thrive, whatever their personal or professional background. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align exactly with every part of the job description, we encourage you to still apply as you may be the right candidate for this role or another opportunity.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------

* Opportunity to work on complex telecom customer journeys, order management, and provisioning solutions.
* Exposure to large-scale enterprise testing programmes and cross-functional delivery environments.
* Collaboration with global business, technology, and supplier stakeholders.
* Experience with modern testing governance, metrics, reporting, and Azure DevOps-based quality management.
* Participation in continuous improvement, automation enablement, and shift-left testing practices.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Advanced System Integration Testing and end-to-end testing methodologies.
* Telecom BSS/OSS domain knowledge and customer journey validation.
* Defect lifecycle management and root cause analysis techniques.
* Test planning, traceability management, quality metrics, and governance practices.
* Test automation support, regression optimisation, and large-scale release testing.
* Stakeholder engagement and cross-functional collaboration skills within global delivery environments.

title: QA Tech Lead
description:
**WHY XOGENE?**

At Xogene, we’re revolutionizing the future of clinical trial transparency through AI-powered solutions. Join our team of experts who are transforming how leading pharmaceutical and life sciences companies navigate regulatory compliance. If you're driven by solving complex problems in a professional environment focused on meaningful and rewarding work, we want to hear from you.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

Xogene combines regulatory expertise with advanced technology to automate complex processes in clinical trial transparency. Our software streamlines workflows through AI and agentic networking capabilities, improving data transformation and regulatory compliance for leading pharmaceutical and life sciences companies. We're committed to advancing technological solutions in clinical trial transparency.

As we continue to expand, we are seeking an experienced QA Tech Lead to drive our test automation initiatives and strengthen our testing strategy. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, the QA Tech Lead will own test automation strategy and execution.

This is a hands-on technical role: you will write and maintain automated tests while guiding the team's automation direction.

**KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead and mentor automation engineers, provide technical guidance to the wider testing team, and foster a culture of quality excellence and continuous improvement.
* Support skill development across the team, including cross-training manual testers in automation (e.g., Playwright Codegen, low-code contributions, and AI-assisted scripting with tools such as Claude) and ensuring automation engineers understand product domain and end-user workflows.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Development, Customer Success, Product Management, Design and Product Support across multiple time zones.
* Define the overall risk-based test strategy, focusing testing effort where regulatory and customer risk is highest, with clear criteria for which tests are automated, which remain manual, and what doesn't need a test at all. Own automation test plans and standards across all Xogene product releases.
* Create and maintain quality metrics, KPIs, and dashboards on testing progress and potential blockers, and provide regular updates to the Director of Engineering.
* Define test scope, objectives, success criteria, and time and resource estimates with stakeholders, and ensure comprehensive coverage through effective test case design and review.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate quality risks throughout each sprint cycle, including during pre-release dry runs.
* Architect, build, and maintain scalable automation testing frameworks, including our custom-built Playwright framework, enforcing code standards, and maximizing test reusability through the Page Object Model (POM).
* Develop and execute automated test scenarios, scripts, and procedures for system, integration, regression, and API testing, growing automated test coverage across all Xogene software products.
* Act as the technical point of contact and subject matter expert on the code and system architecture, diagnosing complex technical problems and designing solutions that reflect lessons learned.
* Identify manual test cases suitable for automation and work with the Test Lead to prioritize and transition them.
* Move automated suites from manual triggers to a tiered CI/CD strategy in GitHub Actions (Smoke, Sanity, and Nightly Regression) that serves as quality gates for developers, and maintain suite health, including resolving flaky tests and tracking automation coverage.
* Oversee the integration between Playwright and Zephyr Scale, reporting test results directly into Zephyr Scale through automated JUnit XML reporting pipelines and maintaining a single source of truth for QA metrics.
* Oversee test environments and test data management, ensuring realistic, compliant test data is available for both manual and automated testing.
* Perform manual testing where automation is impractical, defect triage and resolution, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), contributing automated regression coverage where practical.
* Contribute automation coverage and results to validation documentation, including the Test Plan, Test Summary Report, Traceability Matrix, and UAT Scripts.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* Minimum 7 years of experience in software testing or QA engineering, including at least 2 years in a technical or automation lead role
* Hands-on experience testing large-scale enterprise SaaS web applications and complex software systems, including role-based access controls (RBAC), multi-tenant data isolation, and API integration layers
* Experience leading automation engineers and working closely with manual testers
* Solid understanding of manual testing, including test case design techniques (e.g., boundary value analysis, equivalence partitioning), exploratory testing, and regression planning
* Ability to assess automation ROI and recommend the right balance of manual and automated testing effort based on risk, release cadence, and product maturity
* Expert-level proficiency in Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript or Python), including building frameworks from the ground up using design patterns such as the Page Object Model (POM), plus experience with other automation tools (e.g., Selenium, REST Assured)
* Strong hands-on programming skills (TypeScript, Python, JavaScript) and working knowledge of database technologies
* Proficiency in performance testing tools (JMeter, LoadRunner) and API testing frameworks
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and test integration strategies
* Expertise in the SDLC and test management tools (e.g., Jira, Zephyr Scale), including hands-on experience automating test execution uploads to Zephyr Scale via APIs
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical team members

**DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Ability to balance long-term automation architecture with immediate release needs

* Team leadership skills, including delegating and prioritizing work, giving constructive feedback, and supporting the growth of team members

title: D&T Analyst II – Data Stewardship
description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  

**OVERVIEW**

The Digital and Technology team of General Mills India Centre is looking for a passionate and enthusiastic individual to contribute to the Global Digital Transformation initiative at General Mills in capacity of a D&T Analyst II – Data Stewardship. This role will report into Sr. D&T Manager - Data Stewardship, GDGS team in India and functionally collaborate with stakeholders across the Enterprise teams. It is an Individual contributor role. We are seeking a detail-oriented and forward-thinking Data Steward to support the development and governance of data powering **agentic AI systems** —AI agents capable of autonomous decision-making and task execution. This role ensures data quality, integrity, compliance, and usability across the lifecycle of intelligent agents. This role will work closely with AI engineers, data scientists, product teams, and governance stakeholders to maintain trustworthy, well-structured, and ethically managed datasets that drive reliable agent behaviour.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Define and implement data quality rules (schema validation, referential integrity, distribution checks, drift detection) using Data Quality tools.
* Collaborate with Data Engineers to define and monitor data quality metrics (accuracy, completeness, consistency) essential for high-performing, unbiased AI agents and their tools.
* Monitor dataset health metrics (null ratios, entropy, cardinality, outliers) and set up alerting mechanisms.
* Implement end-to-end **data lineage** across ingestion transformation feature stores model inputs agent outputs.
* Use observability tools (Monte Carlo, etc) to trace data dependencies impacting agent decisions
* Support root cause analysis of agent failures linked to upstream data issues.
* Serve as the primary point of contact between AI/ML Engineers, Data Scientists, Legal/Compliance, and Business Process Owners regarding all data-related aspects of Agentic AI solutions.

* Ensure interoperability across structured data and unstructured data.
* Ensure all data practices related to Agentic AI comply with internal policies and external regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA), paying close attention to the unique compliance risks of autonomous data use
* Establish and enforce data governance policies, standards, and procedures uniquely tailored for AI agents, including data collection, usage, sharing, and retention protocols specific to autonomous and multi-agent systems.
* Enforce **data access controls** , masking, and PII handling in accordance with regulations.
* Maintain audit trails for data used in agent decisions (critical for explainability and compliance).
* Develop and execute procedures for Annual Attestation for Unstructured Data Management Plans (DMP) and Agentic AI Data Management Plans (ADMPs)
* Support DMP/ADMP automation initiatives across BQ, Agentic AI, and other applicable areas of data governance
Establish audit compliance methodology and communication processes (e.g., all data sources/agents have DMP/ADMP, cataloguing of all AI agents, attestation completion)

Bachelor's degree and 8-10 years of total experience

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The Data Center Engineering Operation Engineer is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating within contract parameters within facilities. Often this will be including risk management and mitigation, corrective and preventative maintenance of critical infrastructure, vendor management and metric reporting.  
  

* Responsible for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
* Establish performance benchmarks, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all aspects of the data center facility infrastructure operations and maintenance.
* Work with DCO managers (IT) and other business leaders and operating partners to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability, sustainability and efficiency.
* Responsible for supporting the installation of the racks and the provision of power/cooling.

* Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA).
* Perform rack installs, rack decommissioning, and facility management.
* Provide operational readings and key performance indicators to make sure uptime is maintained
* Responsible for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
* Performance and oversight of maintenance and operations on all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center.
* Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations

  
About the team  
About AWS  
Diverse Experiences
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
Work/Life Balance
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

This role will be accountable to turn domain data into trusted, reusable, and business-ready products that support operational processes, analytics, reporting, and AI use cases.

  
  

The ideal candidate will combine strong business acumen with data experience, partnering across business, technology, architecture, governance, and regional teams to support domain priorities, help maintain authoritative business definitions, and contribute to measurable business value. This is a highly cross-functional role that requires a product mindset, strong stakeholder engagement, and the ability to help translate business needs into scalable, governed data solutions.

  
  

**What can you expect?**
------------------------

* An opportunity to contribute to enterprise data products that support critical business processes and decisions
* Visibility across business, technology, and regional leadership teams
* A highly collaborative role working across architecture, engineering, governance, and operational stakeholders
* The ability to contribute to how data is trusted, reused, and activated across the organization
* An environment focused on business outcomes, measurable value, and enterprise-scale transformation

**What is in it for you?**
--------------------------

* A key contributor role in advancing Marsh's data strategy
* The opportunity to drive real business impact through data product adoption and value realization
* Collaboration with colleagues and cross-functional teams
* Exposure to enterprise architecture, governance, analytics, and AI initiatives
* A culture that values innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement

**We will count on you to:**
----------------------------

* Own the strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for an assigned data domain
* Define domain scope, boundaries, and authoritative business definitions
* Translate business needs into reusable, governed domain data products
* Partner with business sponsors, architects, engineers, and governance teams to deliver domain capabilities
* Support management of the domain backlog, release priorities, and product acceptance criteria
* Ensure the domain supports end-to-end business processes, not just individual systems or datasets
* Lead tracer testing across real business transactions to validate data quality, handoffs, identifiers, and usability
* Drive adoption across operational applications, reporting, analytics, self-service, and AI capabilities
* Establish quality, governance, privacy, and control requirements within the product lifecycle
* Assist in coordinating delivery across global and regional teams, including dependencies, milestones, and risks
* Contribute to measuring domain success through trust, reuse, adoption, and business value
* Escalate unresolved issues related to ownership, quality, capacity, and priorities

**What you need to have:**
--------------------------

* Experience in data products, enterprise data, business data strategy, or product management
* Strong knowledge of business process design and translation of business needs into data requirements
* Experience contributing to delivering data capabilities into production and supporting adoption with business stakeholders
* Working knowledge of data architecture, data modeling, metadata, quality, governance, and integration
* Strong stakeholder collaboration skills across business, technology, operations, and regional teams
* Ability to contribute to cross-functional initiatives without relying solely on direct authority
* Strong prioritization, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex data topics in clear business language
* Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity while driving measurable outcomes

**What makes you stand out?**
-----------------------------

* Experience in insurance, risk, benefits, financial services, or another complex regulated industry
* A product-oriented mindset with a strong focus on adoption, value realization, and business outcomes
* Experience balancing enterprise consistency with regional and business-specific requirements
* Demonstrated success in identifying and resolving data handoff, ownership, and quality issues across end-to-end processes
* Familiarity with data activation across analytics, reporting, operational platforms, and AI use cases

Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. title: AI Platform Lead
description:

* Leads code, design, and release reviews; refactors legacy code, integrates components, resolves defects, and improves application performance.
* Builds automated tests for reliability and regression coverage and advances reusable patterns, development standards, build automation, and continuous delivery.
* Leads major projects or workstreams by estimating effort, managing risks and dependencies, coordinating milestones, and partnering across functions on features and troubleshooting.

**Experience / Qualifications**

* Must be a team player able to work in a fast-paced environment with demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing tasks and demands
* Strong communication skills; oral, written and presentation
* Strong organization, planning and time management skills to achieve results
* Strong personal and professional ethical values and integrity
* Takes ownership of meeting goals and standards
* Proficient in Microsoft Office programs (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel)

* Professional proficiency in spoken and written English
* Experience building and supporting enterprise platforms, shared services, or developer enablement capabilities at scale.
* Strong knowledge of cloud platforms, APIs, platform architecture, system integration, and modern software development practices.
* Experience supporting AI, machine learning, generative AI, or advanced analytics solutions in enterprise environments.
* Knowledge of platform governance, security controls, identity and access management, monitoring, and operational excellence.
* Experience developing scalable services, automation frameworks, and reusable technical capabilities.
* Proven ability to lead complex technical initiatives and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.
* Strong understanding of AI platform operations, usage monitoring, cost management, and performance optimization.

description:
